root_cause.text: Concurrent unsynchronized reads and writes to sk->sk_data_ready and sk->sk_write_space function pointers across multiple CPUs (e.g., due to BPF sockmap updates) cause data races, leading to potential corrupted reads or writes of these pointers.

The commit message explicitly states: "skmsg (and probably other layers) are changing these pointers while other cpus might read them concurrently." The Fixes tag references commit 604326b41a6f ("bpf, sockmap: convert to generic sk_msg interface"), which introduced the concurrent modifications.
